description: This PHP source file defines the class RegistrationEmployeeActivationEventProcessor, which handles processing registration events related to employee activation within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract processor and uses traits to access employee services, providing functionalities to retrieve event type, event data, and determine if the event should be saved based on employee count changes.

classes.name: RegistrationEmployeeActivationEventProcessor
classes.description: Processor class responsible for handling employee activation registration events, providing event type identification, data collection, and logic to determine event persistence based on employee count thresholds.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the specific event type identifier for employee activation events.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Prepares and returns data related to employee activation, including employee count filtered to current employees.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Determines whether to save the event based on whether the employee count crosses a predefined threshold.
